name: stata-research-guard
description: Researcher-readable Stata with original command evidence and concrete independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Readable Stata, original help, concrete peer advice.
interface.longDescription: Write coherent research stages with visible specifications and native Stata commands. Original help and paper context support implementation; fresh peer advice makes refactoring defects explicit. Large help opens with source-section navigation and includes required foundations on selection. Complete source retrieval remains available.
defaultPrompt: Use $stata-replication-workflow to inspect the actual project and write direct researcher-readable Stata. For substantial workflow work, critically read a relevant paper's connected data-to-output code independently of command-help needs. Choose sources yourself, prefer documented command automation, preserve research contracts, and integrate the comparison into existing peer advice and execution review.
